rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when people come face to face, including a planned meeting or a first introduction.

example.english: We will meet in Tsim Sha Tsui tomorrow evening.
example.traditional: 我哋聽晚喺尖沙咀見面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 maan5 hai2 zim1 saa1 zeoi2 gin3 min6

rows.note: Use this for accidentally running into someone or hitting something while moving.

example.english: I happened to meet Ming on the street yesterday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 zong6 dou2 aa3 ming4

rows.note: Use this when a proposal, condition, or requirement satisfies a standard or requirement.

example.english: This proposal is designed to meet the company's requirements.
example.traditional: 呢個方案符合公司要求。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 fu4 hap6 gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when people gather to conduct or attend a meeting.

example.english: We meet at ten in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2 hoi1 wui2
